meta.name: reference-before-plan
meta.description: Research references before creating a Prime Agent plan. Use when repo-change planning needs downloaded projects, articles, papers, docs, per-reference analysis, adoption questions, language settings, and reviewer or criticizer subagents; exclude direct implementation-only, factual/explanation, trivial command-only, or explicit no-plan requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先查资料再定改动方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果动手改代码前想先调研资料并制定稳妥计划
copy.tagline_en: Research references first, then craft a change plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to gather insights before planning code changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在做仓库变更计划前,会先搜索并下载至少 3 份外部参考资料(项目、论文、文档等),逐份分析并记录采用决定,然后才生成计划;参考不足时会暂停等待补充。
howto.when: 当用户要求基于外部资料(论文、项目、文档等)做仓库修改计划,或要求参考下载材料后再规划时触发。

say.text: 先找三篇相关论文下载,再制定这个仓库的修改计划。
say.note: 会先搜索并下载至少3份参考再写 PLAN_v1。

say.text: 参考这些外部文档,分析一下再规划仓库变更。
say.note: 会逐份分析并记录采用问题。

say.text: 先研究几个相关项目,给出采用建议,再出计划。
say.note: 会执行参考研究流程后生成计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will research and download at least 3 external references (projects, papers, docs, etc.), analyze each and record adoption decisions before writing the plan; if insufficient references, it blocks and waits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for repo-change planning that needs external references like papers, projects, or docs, or requests researching downloaded material before planning.

say_en.text: Download three related papers, then plan the repo changes.
say_en.note: Searches and downloads at least 3 references first.

say_en.text: Review these external docs, analyze them, then plan the repo change.
say_en.note: Each reference is analyzed and adoption questions recorded.

say_en.text: Research a few related projects and give adoption tips before planning.
say_en.note: Runs the reference flow before producing the plan.
